neighbours.label: the token ' real' (also 'real', ' Real'), strongest where a compound follows: real world, real life, real time, real estate
fire: The textbook explains each formula with real world cases from industry.

The dashboard updates in real time as orders arrive.
His uncle made a fortune in real estate near the harbour.
Students solve real world problems in the final project.
The film is loosely based on a real life robbery in Lyon.
Sensors report the bridge's load in real time to the engineers.
They hired a real estate agent to sell the farm.

notes: Card: ' real' x19, 'real' x6, ' Real' x4; output promotes ' life', ' world' and suppresses ' real'. Probes: real world 0.66, real estate 0.57, real time 0.53, real life 0.40; plain adjective uses (a real pleasure, a real diamond) 0.19-0.23; 'practical examples' 0.02.
